events.continuity_hook: Completes the main Asheville booking decision after the lodge and Greenville routing became the strongest practical pairing.
events.interaction_goal: Book the Greenville flights and rental car if prices still hold, reserve the lodge with the parking and cancellation terms clearly noted, choose the best available adjacent seats, and set a simple Friday arrival plan.
events.scenario_brief: Kara and her partner decide that flying into Greenville with a compact rental car is more practical than driving from Tampa, because the Monday afternoon return still gets her home with room for Tuesday prep. The mountain lodge confirms the queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness room; the only real drawbacks are the nightly parking fee, the drive from Greenville, and the two-night cancellation cutoff. Adjacent seats are available on the outbound, with Kara able to sit by the window, while the return has limited seat choice.

events.continuity_hook: Tightens the Asheville plan now that lodging is booked and local conditions affect the hiking schedule more than the hotel choice.
events.interaction_goal: Adjust the Saturday trail plan, confirm the Greenville pickup and return timing, decide whether to stop for groceries before reaching the lodge, and set a Monday departure sequence that protects the afternoon flight.
events.scenario_brief: A week before the Asheville weekend, the lodge confirms the hot tub will be open but warns that one section of the pool deck may be under repair on Friday. A Blue Ridge Parkway closure changes the easiest trail access for Saturday, and the rental car office at Greenville advises allowing extra time for holiday-weekend pickup. The Monday afternoon flight remains workable, but Kara wants to avoid building the return day too tightly around checkout, gas, and the airport drive.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new clinic-training episode after the personal recovery weekend, with schedule reliability and room basics driving the comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Compare Monday outbound and Wednesday-or-Thursday return patterns, weigh the clinic-rate hotel against the more predictable suite property, and identify what the host must confirm about setup access, parking, and final dismissal time.
events.scenario_brief: After the Asheville weekend, a pediatric outpatient clinic outside Kansas City asks Kara to lead a Tuesday-Wednesday staff training in mid-June. She needs to arrive Monday early enough to review the treatment space and leave time for demo-equipment setup. Wednesday could finish around 4:00 p.m., making a same-evening return possible but rushed, while a Thursday afternoon return would be easier on the next workday. The nearest clinic-rate hotel is convenient but has uneven ratings and unclear bedding and fridge details; a better-rated suite property 15 minutes away confirms a queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, and fitness room but has no hot tub and only a small indoor pool.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Kansas City training from comparison to booking once the host clarifies access and the Wednesday finish time.
events.interaction_goal: Book the Monday outbound and Thursday afternoon return, reserve the suite hotel if the cancellation terms are acceptable, choose between a rental car and rideshares, and select a window seat where available.
events.scenario_brief: The Kansas City clinic confirms Monday room access from 3:00 to 5:30 p.m., locked storage for Kara's demo materials, and a Wednesday wrap-up that could run to 4:15 p.m. The Thursday afternoon return is still reasonably priced and avoids a late airport sprint after teaching. The suite hotel keeps the clearer room setup with queen bedding, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool; the clinic-rate option still cannot confirm the room amenities. Rideshares price close to a compact rental car, but a rental would make the clinic commute and grocery stop easier.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes practical Kansas City logistics after booking, with a modest flight change and clearer campus access instructions.
events.interaction_goal: Decide whether the shifted outbound still works, map Monday airport-to-hotel-to-clinic timing, set Tuesday and Wednesday morning departure times, and keep the Thursday afternoon return plan aligned with checkout.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Kansas City training, the airline shifts the Monday connection 25 minutes later, but Kara still lands with enough time to reach the hotel before the clinic setup window. The hotel reconfirms the queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and pool access, while the clinic sends a campus map showing a visitor lot on the opposite side of the rehab entrance. The unresolved pieces are whether to keep the shifted flight, how early to leave the hotel each morning, and where to fit a light grocery stop without making Monday feel overloaded.

events.continuity_hook: Begins the next summer teaching episode after the Kansas City clinic visit, this time with cross-country timing and campus proximity creating the main trade-offs.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the Friday outbound and Monday return flight patterns, shortlist the campus guesthouse against the suite hotel, and list what needs confirmation about Friday lab access, Sunday teardown, campus parking, and room amenities before booking.
events.scenario_brief: Kara is invited to teach a Saturday-Sunday pediatric orthotics lab at a university facility in Portland in late July. She wants to arrive Friday with enough time to check in, review the lab layout, and rest before an early Saturday start; the Sunday debrief may run late enough that a Monday return is the cleaner choice. Tampa-to-Portland options involve connections, with one Friday morning itinerary giving the safest arrival and a cheaper later routing leaving little margin for setup. The campus guesthouse is closest but has older reviews, no clear fridge information, and limited fitness access, while a nearby suite hotel has stronger ratings, queen studio availability, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool but no hot tub and a short rideshare to campus.
